# wso2is_branding_preference (Resource)

Manages the branding of the login, registration, account recovery and My Account pages. The branding applies to the whole organization or to one application. To import, use the ID `ORG/<tenant>/<locale>` or `APP/<application_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wso2is_branding_preference" "org" {
  locale = "en-US"
  preference = jsonencode({
    configs = { isBrandingEnabled = true }
    organizationDetails = {
      displayName  = "Acme"
      supportEmail = "support@acme.example"
    }
    images = {
      logo = { imgURL = "https://cdn.acme.example/logo.svg", altText = "Acme" }
    }
    theme = {
      activeTheme = "LIGHT"
      LIGHT       = { colors = { primary = { main = "#FF7300" } } }
    }
    layout = { activeLayout = "centered" }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `preference` (String) Branding preference document (use `jsonencode`), as in the Console's *Branding* section: `configs` (`isBrandingEnabled`, `removeDefaultBranding`, `selfSignUpEnabled`), `organizationDetails` (`displayName`, `supportEmail`, `siteTitle`, `copyrightText`), `images` (`logo`, `favicon`, `myAccountLogo`), `urls` (`privacyPolicyURL`, `termsOfUseURL`, `cookiePolicyURL`), `theme` (`activeTheme`, `LIGHT`/`DARK` colors, fonts, buttons, inputs, `loginBox`, `footer`), and `layout` (`activeLayout`: `centered`, `left-image`, `right-aligned`, `custom`, ...). The server stores the document as given.

### Optional

- `application_id` (String) Application ID, for `type = "APP"`.
- `locale` (String) Locale, for example `en-US` (default) or `fr-FR`.
- `type` (String) `ORG` (the organization, default) or `APP` (one application).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<type>/<name>/<locale>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import wso2is_branding_preference.org ORG/carbon.super/en-US
```
